tests.goal: Confirm that a memory can be created, edited and deleted manually through the UI

steps.action: Open the avatar menu > Settings > Memories.
Click "Add a memory", fill in the inline form and click Create.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is created and listed

steps.action: Ask a query that relies on the new memory in a chat.
acceptanceCriteria: The new memory is used in the reply

steps.action: Open the memory in Settings > Memories, edit it and save.
acceptanceCriteria: The edited memory is shown in the list

steps.action: Ask a query that relies on the edited memory.
acceptanceCriteria: The edited memory is used in the reply

steps.action: Delete the memory.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is removed from the list

steps.action: Ask the same query again.
acceptanceCriteria: The deleted memory is no longer used

tests.goal: Confirm that a memory can be created, edited and deleted via chat with an agent, with human approval (HITL)

steps.action: Create or select an agent that has the memory tool enabled.
Ask the agent to save a new memory (e.g. "I'm working on a Deloitte internal AI tool, MyAssist. Please remember that for future discussions.").
acceptanceCriteria: An approval card appears inline showing the proposed memory with Reject and Approve options
"Will be created" is shown in green
Nothing is saved until the request is approved

steps.action: Click the pencil icon on the approval card to edit the memory.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is edited inline, not in a popup dialog
Changes are reflected on the card

steps.action: Approve the request.
acceptanceCriteria: The "memory updated" chip appears
The memory is saved with a relevant header in Settings > Memories

steps.action: Ask the agent to update the existing memory.
acceptanceCriteria: An approval card appears
"Will be updated" is shown in green
The memory only changes once approved

steps.action: Ask the agent to delete the memory, then reject the request.
acceptanceCriteria: "Will be deleted" is shown in red with the trash icon
The memory is still present after rejecting

steps.action: Ask the agent to delete the memory again and approve the request.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is removed from the Memory panel

steps.action: Click the pencil icon on the approval card to edit the memory.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is edited inline, not in a popup dialog
Changes are reflected on the card

steps.action: Approve the request.
acceptanceCriteria: The "memory updated" chip appears
The memory is saved with a relevant header in Settings > Memories

steps.action: Ask the model to update the existing memory.
acceptanceCriteria: An approval card appears
"Will be updated" is shown in green
The memory only changes once approved

steps.action: Ask the model to delete the memory, then reject the request.
acceptanceCriteria: "Will be deleted" is shown in red with the trash icon

steps.action: Ask the model to delete the memory again and approve the request.

tests.goal: Confirm that a saved memory is retrieved ad hoc in a new chat

steps.action: Ensure a memory exists (e.g. "I really like it when you tell me jokes" or "I'm working on MyAssist").
Start a new chat.
Ask "What do you know about me?" or "What am I working on?".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply references the saved memory
